name: @acamarata/pray-calc
description: Zero-dependency TypeScript prayer time calculation library — PrayCalc Dynamic Method (NREL SPA + MSC seasonal + dynamic twilight angles)

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && find dist/cjs -name '*.js' | while read f; do mv "$f" "${f%.js}.cjs"; done && find dist/cjs -name '*.cjs' -exec perl -pi -e 's|require\\(([\'"])(\\.{1,2}/[^\'"]+)\\.js\\1\\)|require($1$2.cjs$1)|g' {} + && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json
